_comment: #475. The Doelger plan literally is a garage leaf with a round-head entry beside it, so both
live on floor 0 and windows start at floor 1. Same slotting as noe_valley_victorian, and for
the same schema reason (see the long note there): exclusion is exact -> procedural only, so
floor 0 holds one exact (the door) plus one rule (the garage) and nothing else.
Gates: countMin 0 with spacingMeters 4.2 across a 0.76 span means no garage below 5.53 m;
avoidExact with minSpacingMeters 2.1 suppresses the slot below 5.38 m. A 2.99 m garage and a
0.95 m door touch below 5.05 m, so the pair cannot overlap. A Sunset lot is 25 ft (7.6 m), so
in practice every Doelger house gets both.
window minSpacingMeters 2.25 -> 2.40 stays under repeat.spacingMeters 3.0, so the slider
rhythm is unchanged and only the exclusion radius grows.
window_sunset_2x3 joins as a variant - postwar Sunset carries both the aluminium slider and
the 2x3 casement, and a variant list is the only way one rule reaches more than one preset.
